simple.meaning: שָׁבִיל (shâbîyl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a track or passage-way (as if flowing along).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: a track or passage-way (as if flowing along)
definitions.full: H7635. shebil or shebul שְׁבִיל שְׁבוּל, noun [masculine] way, path (properly as flowing along, stretching out ? compare Late Hebrew שְׁבִיל , Arabic ); Aramaic שְׁבִילָא ); — plural suffix בְּמַיִם וּשְׁבִילְיךָ֯ רַבִּים [Kt שְׁבִילְךָ Psa 77:20 (of ׳י ; || דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ ); construct (figurative of course of life) עוֺלָם שְׁבוּלֵי Jer 18:15 (Kt; Qr שְׁבִילֵי ; || דְּרָכִים ).
